# Jwalith T Suresh — Developer Portfolio

> Jwalith T Suresh (JTS) is a Full-Stack Web Developer, Discord & Telegram Bot Developer, and Python Automation Specialist based in Kerala, India.

## Core Specializations

- [Web Development](https://jtsdev.space/#portfolio): Fast, responsive frontends built with React.js, HTML/CSS, PHP, and Django.
- [Bot Development](https://jtsdev.space/#portfolio): Interactive Discord and Telegram bot engines built with discord.js, python-telegram-bot, and custom API integrations.
- [Automation Workflows](https://jtsdev.space/#portfolio): Python automation scripts, web scrapers, data parsers, and custom backend schedulers.
